状态点：实心=已配对且指纹已核对（信任设备），空心=未配对/未验证；颜色：实心绿: Status dot: filled = paired with a verified fingerprint (trusted device), hollow = not paired / not verified. Colors: filled green = live link (these are the devices that receive the broadcasts you drop on the orb), blue = online (reachable, but no automatic broadcast), grey = offline, amber = this device is waiting, red = re-pairing needed (red is always hollow: a broken relationship never counts as a trusted device).
胶囊上那几个字说的是关系与链路，与点不重复 —— 行上不再另挂一枚「自动广播」标: The chip words describe the relationship and the link; they don't repeat the dot — rows carry no extra “auto broadcast” tag, and the dot color alone shows which devices receive broadcasts (green is reserved for live links).
点击设备行或「发消息」按钮都能打开与这台设备的会话 —— 消息长连接优先、HTT: Clicking the device row or the Message button opens the conversation with this device — messages prefer the live link and fall back to HTTP: paired devices can send and receive without tapping Connect, and unpaired devices can too (the peer name is what it reports about itself). When the peer is offline the message queues and is sent automatically once it comes online (the UI shows “waiting to send” meanwhile). Paired devices tap Connect to open a live link (pairing alone doesn't connect). Devices on a live link automatically receive files you drop on the orb, no per-file action needed. Devices still linked when you shut down reconnect the next time OrbDrop starts (unless Disconnect was tapped).
已配对但离线的设备排在列表下方（在线的在上），可以「解除配对」—— 解除是本机动: Paired but offline devices are listed below online ones and can be unpaired — unpairing is a local action that doesn't need the peer online.
推送在会话里（输入框左边那颗「＋」）：选文件发过去就是推送 —— 一对一发给这一: Push lives in the conversation (the “+” left of the input): pick files and send them to push — one-to-one chats go to this device only; broadcast conversations have the same “+”, sending to every device on the list at once (separate invites, separate progress). New conversation picks several devices and a mode at once: one-way broadcast gives each device its own separate message, while a shared group chat is a single message stream for everyone (invitees must tap Join to enter the group); group conversations also have that “+” to push to each member on the roster.
搜索框只在这里筛显示（显示名或 IP），不影响长连接与消息。: The search box only filters this list (display name or IP); it doesn't affect links or messages.
右键设备行可以「修改备注」：备注只存在本机（对端看不到），设好之后这一行显示成「: Right-click a device row to edit its note: notes stay on this device (the peer can't see them). Once set, the row shows “note (device name)” — everywhere else (conversations, tab bar, recipient picker…) only the note is used; hover a long name to see it in full.

对方此刻联系不上（探活不成）。这一行只是它最近还在这片网上的痕迹；它上线后就能「: The device can't be reached right now (it doesn't answer probes). This row is just a trace of it being on this network recently; once it's online you can pair or message it (messages queue until then).
本机还在等它：一出现在网上就自动接回长连接。: This device is still waiting: the live link reconnects as soon as it shows up.
它上线后这一行会回到在线，长连接是否接回仍按本机「连接」记忆走。: This row returns to online once the device is back; whether the link reconnects still follows the remembered Connect state here.
